_provenance.purpose: End-to-end chains of SAP scope items per value stream, used by the To-Be Process Pack's L1 diagram (2608 WS6, extended WS16). Repo-authored — not an SAP download.
_provenance.source: WS6 pilot definition in docs/2608/CLAUDE-CODE-MASTER-PROMPT-2608-and-tobe-process-pack.md (Order-to-Cash: 1IQ → BDG → BD9 → J59, plus 2ET). WS16 added seven finance and procurement chains. SAP's Process Navigator business-process hierarchy is not in the 2608 content drop and was NOT read for this file; add chains only with their source.
_provenance.orderingCaveat: Chain MEMBERSHIP is traceable: every code below is a 2608 scope item, and the grouping follows the process areas SAP itself uses in the BDC questionnaires (S4H_405 Finance, S4H_420 Sourcing and Procurement, S4H_433 Sales). Chain ORDER is not published by SAP anywhere in the 2608 drop, so the sequences here are consultant-asserted and must be confirmed in Fit-to-Standard. Each chain says so in its own source line. Do not present an L1 chain as SAP-cited.

alternates.note: Sales Order Processing for Non-Stock Material (2ET) replaces Sell from Stock (BD9) for non-stock material.

chains.name: Procure to Pay — requisition to payment

alternates.note: Procurement of Services (22Z) replaces Consumable Purchasing (BNX) where the requisition is for a service rather than a material.
Purchase Contract (BMD) supplies the source of supply and the agreed price where a contract already exists.
Supplier Classification and Segmentation (19E) and Complementary Procurement Functions (2TW) govern the supplier and the source before a requisition can be released against it.
Automated Invoice Settlement (2LH) replaces supplier invoice entry where settlement is on the goods receipt.
Predictive Commitments Management (2I3) carries the commitment from requisition through purchase order to invoice, which is what a real-time budget check reads.

chains.source: WS16, repo-authored. Membership from the SAP BDC questionnaire S4H_420 Sourcing and Procurement process areas (2608); ordering consultant-asserted, not SAP-published — confirm in Fit-to-Standard.

chains.name: Order to Cash — service billing to collection

alternates.note: Basic Credit Management (BD6) checks the customer limit before the billing document is released.
Credit Memo Processing (1EZ) and Invoice Correction Process with Credit Memo (BKL) handle a downward correction to an issued invoice.
Debit Memo Processing (1F1) and Invoice Correction Process with Debit Memo (BDQ) handle an upward correction.
Cash Application Integration (1MV) matches incoming payments to open items automatically, so only the unmatched residue reaches collections.
Provisioning of Overdue Receivables (2PD) values the exposure before the collection strategy runs.

chains.source: WS16, repo-authored. Membership from the SAP BDC questionnaire S4H_405 Finance (Accounts Receivable) and S4H_433 Sales process areas (2608); ordering consultant-asserted, not SAP-published — confirm in Fit-to-Standard.

chains.name: Record to Report — period close to consolidation

alternates.note: Intercompany Financial Posting (1GP) and Billing of Costs Between Affiliated Companies (3ZB) create the intercompany positions that Intercompany Reconciliation (40Y) then matches.
Group Valuation (5W2) where the group view of a transaction differs from the local one.
Organizational Flexibility in Financial Accounting (4PG) where the organisational structure changes inside a fiscal year.

chains.source: WS16, repo-authored. Membership from the SAP BDC questionnaire S4H_405 Finance (Accounting and Financial Close, General Settings) process areas (2608); ordering consultant-asserted, not SAP-published — confirm in Fit-to-Standard.

chains.name: Acquire to Retire — fixed assets

alternates.note: Asset Accounting – Additional Depreciation Area (5HG) where a further valuation is kept alongside the local and group ones.

chains.source: WS16, repo-authored. Membership from the SAP BDC questionnaire S4H_405 Finance (Asset Accounting) process area (2608); ordering consultant-asserted, not SAP-published — confirm in Fit-to-Standard.

chains.name: Cash and bank operations

alternates.note: Bank Integration with SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity (16R) replaces the file interface where the bank supports it.
Direct Debit (19M) collects from customer accounts through the same bank channel the statements arrive on.
Intercompany Foreign Exchange Management (2F2) where cash moves between currencies inside the group.

chains.source: WS16, repo-authored. Membership from the SAP BDC questionnaire S4H_405 Finance (Payments & Receipts, Bank) process areas (2608); ordering consultant-asserted, not SAP-published — confirm in Fit-to-Standard.

chains.name: Plan to Perform — budget, plan and project control

alternates.note: Predictive Commitments Management (2I3) brings committed but uninvoiced spend into the plan-versus-actual view, which is what a budget holder is actually asking to see.

chains.source: WS16, repo-authored. Membership from the SAP BDC questionnaire S4H_405 Finance (Profitability and Cost Analysis, Planning) process areas (2608); ordering consultant-asserted, not SAP-published — confirm in Fit-to-Standard.
